SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT KALABURAGI IN MVC NO. 961/2020 AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO AWARD ENHANCED COMPENSATION TO THE APPELLANT HEREIN.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is filed by the claimant, assailing the judgment and award dated 10.08.2022 in MVC No.961/2020, on the file of I Addl. Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi, seeking enhancement of compensation.

In so far as award of compensation is concerned, on careful consideration of the evidence of P.W.2 and the wound certificate at Ex.P5 as well as disability Hemanth @ Hemadreppa Chakrasali vs Vadlamudi Mayadri And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168883891/

sentences.text: 2 certificate at Ex.P11, makes it clear that the claimant has sustained grievous injuries and accordingly, the disability has to be taken at 15% to the whole body.
In view of the fact that the accident is of the year 2019, the monthly income of the claimant has to be taken at Rs.13,250/- as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.

By applying the appropriate multiplier of 18, the claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.4,29,300/- (13250 x 18 x 15% x 18)
towards loss of future income.

4. Taking into account the discussion made above, as well as Ex.P11, the re-assessment of compensation is made as under:
NC: 2026:KHC-K:981 HC-KAR Heads Amount (in Rupees) Pain and suffering 50,000.00
Loss of amenities 50,000.00
Loss of income during treatment 39,750.00 (13,250 x 3) Loss of future earnings 4,29,300.00
Towards diet and conveyance 20,000.00 charges
Medical expenses 90,000.00 Future medical expenses 20,000.00 Total 6,99,050.00 5.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The Miscellaneous First Appeal is allowed in part.

(ii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.6,99,050/- (as against Rs.5,22,100/- awarded by the Tribunal), with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:981 HC-KAR (iii) In all other respects, the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal shall remain unaltered.
Accordingly, the Judgment and Award dated 10.08.2022 in MVC No.961/2020, on the file of I Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi, shall stand modified.
